title: Boltzmann Factor and Partition Functions (Summary)
notes: Written by Kyle Crabtree; the chapter's learning objectives, which the book prints on this page, are kept here.

footnotes.html: This chapter's pages do not teach the principle of equal a priori probabilities, Bose-Einstein and Fermi-Dirac statistics, entropy from the partition function, simple diatomic models for state populations, or temperatures and number densities from the intensities of a spectrum; the objectives and skill goals that name them refer to material the built pages leave out.
